title: this cannot be stopped, its done
tags: the culture war with tim pool
description:
Gen Z is facing a surge in gambling addiction as digital betting, loot boxes, and online casinos become more accessible than ever. New York State is now taking legal action against game companies over loot boxes, raising major questions about regulation and consumer protection. As casinos and betting platforms continue to expand rapidly, concerns are growing about long-term impacts on younger generations.
